title: Documents, Decision and Acceptance Timetable for the Hardship Assistance Programs
content:
For every program of the Hardship Assistance Programs this timetable states which documents must be received before a decision, how long the borrower has to provide them, how quickly the decision is made once they are on file, and whether and for how long the borrower accepts offered terms.

| Program | Documents required before a decision | Days to provide documents | Decision within (business days) | Borrower acceptance required | Days to accept |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | none | 0 | 2 | yes | 10 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | income statement or termination notice | 14 | 3 | yes | 10 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | income statement | 14 | 3 | yes | 10 |
| Term Extension Modification | income statement and bank statement | 21 | 5 | yes | 14 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | FEMA registration | 30 | 2 | no | 0 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | military orders | 30 | 5 | no | 0 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | none | 0 | 5 | yes | 10 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Documents required**: documents that must be received before a decision; any one of a list separated by "or", all of a list otherwise. The Reduced Payment Plan is satisfied by either an income statement or a termination notice; the Term Extension Modification needs both an income statement and a bank statement.
- **Days to provide documents**: calendar days after the request date to provide required documents before the request is declined; 0 when no documents are required.
- **Decision within**: business days after all required documents are on file within which a decision is made.
- **Borrower acceptance required**: whether the borrower must accept and e-sign offered terms ("yes") or the benefit is applied directly once its evidence is on file ("no").
- **Days to accept**: calendar days after the decision date during which offered terms can be accepted; 0 when applied without acceptance.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- A Term Extension Modification request with only an income statement on file does not yet have every required document; one with a termination notice in place of the income statement does not either.
- A Disaster Relief Deferral and a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit carry no acceptance period: once their evidence is on file the benefit is applied directly.
